subject: reasoning
question:
Choose the pair that best expresses a relationship NOT similar to the given pair.

Gold : Ornament
solution:
The logic followed here is :

**"Gold"** is used to make an **"Ornament"**.

Similarly,

(1)** "Cotton"** is used to make **"Cloth"**.

(2) **"Wood"** is used to make **"Paper"**.

(4) **"Clay"** is used to make a **"Pot"**.

But,

**(3) "Water"** and **"Ice"** are the same substance in different states and not a material-product relationship.

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (3)"**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
